description: animsmith: on SessionStart, print the vault path (ANIMSMITH_VAULT), the reference cards per category, pending Breakdowns, files waiting in the inbox and any build waiting for its approval write-up; on SessionEnd, mark open builds paused. One command line runs under bash/sh and under PowerShell (the bash branch ends before the PowerShell block comment closes). Never fails: both scripts exit 0 here.

hooks.command: echo `# <#` >/dev/null; python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/kit/scripts/session_hook.py"; exit 0 #> >$null; $r = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; python "$r/kit/scripts/session_hook.py"; exit 0

echo `# <#` >/dev/null; python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/kit/scripts/ledger.py" pause-open; exit 0 #> >$null; $r = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; python "$r/kit/scripts/ledger.py" pause-open; exit 0
